book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Mak girumalena

content: Iesu apana bedewe aleu kadiu waimoia inasade
Iesu wawe alala do doa Galili nawane antone waiwa dawo Gerasa tawowa bedewe wimoiena.
Ita Iesu waa bedewe nosedio apana bedewe aleu kadiu waimoia bo gubauwo wandi leidia nosene Iesu donsan.

Me bo gubauwo wanwanlala. Me dewawa kadiwa baiwa apana walama uara witapa ita wawa seni mampe taumoio tane me epapuialeidie edie aleide. Mai mida da kasawoga ita me wadepiitue taupia rua, dia, sa baiwa mo eiena.
Me wadi bedewainta bo gubauwo wandi leidie. Me walama ita tadina ruawaleidie mukama ke wadie rasaleidie meba etepa seu mampe epakeialeidie.
Me Iesu eseanamaido ewene weuwane alene Iesu mampe wisen.

Ita Iesu me diene wanase, “Aleu kadiwa apana ema bedewe wainiana ee noe nambe aitaa!” Me ema etene Iesu danawe imimpa emmisilene mukama siribabalene wane wanase, “Iesu, God ionoidoa Otopa, e mai nolaa da ne mainawo wineipona, dia. E God ebowa mampe sauanea mai kadineawo poka etapa!”
Mape Iesu me waitarasane wanase, “E eboa ambi?” Ita me sipoasane wanase, “Ne ebona Uaraia, ipawa no aleu kadiwa uaraia mape wainitana.”
Me Iesu kainokaino iririsadia aleu kadiu mai tanamopio tawo sa epue nambe antopu, dia.
Tane walamaipa bono uara wadi sainape maida lodontoie laie.
Ita aleu kadiu Iesu iririsane waienase, “No menanedia bono sa bedeuwo ane wainenta.”
Dima mo iririwantoiena Iesu oaleno ita aleu kadiu apana ene nomone bono bedeuwo antoiena. Tane bono uaraia sa, wisia 2000, weuwane dai debama bedewe antoieno doa numamon.

Bono oniamoia apanawa dima bono mampo segaleno ewane tauwadea weuwane antone bola debama ita kerakera bedeuwointa apana benemamoiena. Ita apana benema sa etane bolau ene doa tampe antoiena dima segalena ewapua baiwa.

Mo Iesu mampe wimone apana mida bauta aleu kadiu bedewe wanwanlala gara taudewasalene insaisawa dodomana euda wandio ewane saidantone inseienase, “Ambi ipa ema epe, apana ema dewawa dodomanaleno wande?”
Ita mo mida dima segaleno eweiena apana wimoiena mampo benemantoiena. Mo apana aleu kadiwa bedewe wanwanlala eulena benemawa ita do dima bono mampo segalena benemawa wane diamoiena.
Mo ema etane Iesu badowa iririsaiena bolau epie alepi.
Ita Iesu waa bedewe odepia baiwaleidio apana inalena Iesu do antopona baiwa iririleidie.
Tane Iesu me wanitudena mai do antopu, dia, ita diene wanase, “E bolaawo aite gombaaida mampo ginasa debamawa Tatamba manawo dewasana ita do ambi e nuaparealene inaena benemawaitawo atentopu.”
Iesu wana rua me ene bola Dekapolis bedeuwointa alene Iesu ginasa debamawa me mampe dewasana umanawa apana benemamodie. Ita apana uduudu ema etane memesanton.
Iesu i kerolala inasade ita Iairas anoopa bo bedewe inasadio enediwisede
Tane Iesu bola sa ene waa asiasi nawene doa waiwa dawo leulene alene wisedio apana uaraia wimone sape auweiena.
Ita gagalo duwa bedewe apana auweio oniamodia apanawa ebowa Iairas do sape wisen. Ita me Iesu ewene wawa bumpe imimpa emmisilene
nuawa uduudu mampe Iesu iririsane wanase, “Winea, ne anona kerauda bo baiwaleide, ne menanedia e witaa osowe ituwo inalepi.”
Iesu me nata antoio apana uara mo wauwontoie apisamoiena.
Ita apana uara bedeuwo i kerowa etepe osina weuwadia enawa 12 diantona sape leidie.
Me pokaida etedie doketa uara mampo alen sausapono inalepona baiwa ita manewa uduudu mampe wineia di diasan, mai inalepona, tane kerowa debamaleidio wandie.
Me Iesu benemawa etena baiwa apana uara auweio bedewe wisene Iesu adiweinta mampelene garawa moawa os waden.
Me epe dewalena ipawa me insenase, “Naita ne Iesu garawa wirasapa ne inanteapa.”
Me Iesu garawa moawa wadedio osina etepe weuwadia dialen ita me tauwadea dauwa etene atenlen me inalen.
I sa Iesu garawa wirasadio kerolala inamompaa mukawa me mampe nosedio dauwa etene apana uara bedeuwo leulene enene waitaralene wanase, “Mida ne garana wirasan?”
Tane wawe alala leusane Iesu diane waienase, “E apana uaraia do apiapisaitile eneile bedewe e waitaraitie waianase, ‘Mida ne wiranen?’”
Tane Iesu apana uaraia tampe eneia bedeuwo mida me wirasana ewabanuleidie atensapona baiwa.
Tane i inalena meba ateatenlene baiwa sa ita uwauwa etepe odedio Iesu mampe wisene wawa bumpe imimpa emmisilene wasabamowa wane dima dewasana umanawa dientuwan.
Ita Iesu i diene wanase, “Anona, mai nuabolaitaa, nuaeu mampe bolaawo aitaa, e sumanaia inaen, poka eteiana tauma dialen.”
Iesu i sa mampe gagaloleidio, apana isiwa Iairas duwee wimone ita Iairas diane waienase, “E anoa aitamana bolen, Iesu surakauwa ea.”
Mo dima waia Iesu etene mai insepona, dia, tane Iairas diene wanase, “Mai insaisaa nosepio inguguraitaa, sumanaitaa!”
Iesu apana uduudu wawentoia waitumona mo wankasantopua baiwa. Tane me menasana Pita ita Iems wamba Ion nata mo os do antopu.
Mo Iairas duwa mampentoie apana uara sape ke waie nuapareparentoio ewamoiena.
Ita Iesu du bedewe odene apana ke waio diamone wanase, “E dima baiwa ke waile nuaparepareitilana? Oto mai bolepona, di ituleide.”
Mo Iesu epe wadio etane me oiwa waiena. Tane Iesu apana sa uduudu waaubamono nomone antoiena. Ita oto mamba inawa nata, do wawe alala natadea Iesu do wimoiena oto ituleidiawo odane antoiena.
Sape Iesu oto witapa wadene diene wanase, “Talita koumi!” Aia ema ipawaida ipa ema epe: I sanaa kerauda, ne dieedina enawiea!
Iesu wadio i kerauda tauwadea enenwisene sape leidie. Me muwa enawa 12 dialen. Tane apana uara sape waimoia i sanaa kerauda inawaa leidio ewane memesaidanton.
Ita Iesu mo badowa anaanamona dima segalena umanawa mai wapue apana da benemamopu, dia. Ita Iesu diamona oto inalena nana da wanapuo napi.
